Name: Simple Foliage - Unofficial Update for 1.6
Author: Morghoula
Description:
[size=4][center][b][quote][color=#ffff00]April 03, 2024 Update: itsannette has contacted me to let me know they are working on an official update (YAY!). Once it is released, this mod will be taken down.﻿ Please download the official version when the time comes and support the original creator. Thank you everyone![/color][/quote]

[color=#674ea7]This is an unofficial update for [/color][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8164]Simple Foliage[/url][color=#674ea7] (originally by itsanette), adding in the new 1.6 trees and bushes. A big shoutout to [/color][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/54445652]tophatta [/url][color=#674ea7]﻿for helping put together some new assets - without them, this wouldn't be possible![/color][/b][/center][/size]

[img]https://i.ibb.co/KjG9ptb/features.png[/img]
[spoiler]
[list]
[*]Moss on all base trees
[*]The 4 new major tree assets that came with 1.6: the green rain event trees and the mystic tree.
[*]The new bushes and weeds that appear during the green rain event.
[*]A change to the code that ensures Simple Foliage has priority of tilesheets, so it should be compatible with recolors and other mods which also try to change the same tilesheets.
[/list][/spoiler]
[list]
[/list][color=#e69138][b][size=4]
[img]https://i.ibb.co/SfBf1SL/important-notes.png[/img]
[/size][/b][list]
[*][color=#e69138]If you had any trees that already had moss on them prior to installing this mod, you may encounter a visual glitch on those particular trees, where their bare and moss-covered sprites are reversed. You will not encounter this on any new mossy trees going forward so the issue will resolve itself. THIS IS ONLY A TEMPORARY GLITCH AND IS UNFIXABLE. PLEASE DO NOT REPORT IT.[/color]
[/list][/color]

[b][u][size=3][img]https://i.ibb.co/XYdBFhX/installation.png[/img]
[/size][/u][/b][list]
[*]If you currently have Simple Foliage installed, completely delete it from your mods folder.
[*]Download this version and extract it to your mods folder.
[*]Run the game once to allow it to create a config file. Then you can begin customizing your assets. For more details on how to use and configure the mod itself, please check out[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8164] the original mod page[/url]﻿. 
[/list]
